title: Vectors: gcp_slot_claim_cose_sign1.json + generator (replay/expiry/mutation cases)
description:
Canonical test vectors + generator for GCP-6.5 slot-claim COSE_Sign1, focused on the parent bead's deltas (signature coverage of slots/expiry/claim_seq, replay gate, expiry, header-encoding bug). Complements — does not duplicate — qpco.4/qpco.8 (happy-path COSE cases); coordinate file naming so both land: propose test/vectors/gcp_slot_claim_cose_sign1.json + test/vectors/generate_gcp_slot_claim_cose_sign1.py.

Generator modeled on test/vectors/generate_gcp_handoff_cose_sign1.py (RFC 9052 Sig_structure :67, SHA256(CBOR(Sig_structure)) signing input, deterministic keys fixed for reproducibility — never derive vectors from the C/Python code under test; the generator + spec are the oracle).

Required cases (each: valid-sig positive and byte-level mutation negative where applicable):
1. happy_path_n1 / n4 / n60 — payload keys 1-7 (slots, superframe_epoch, mode, expiry, gateway_iid, claim_seq, ordinal), canonical CBOR field order 1..7 (RFC 8949 4.2.1; all single-byte keys sort numerically). Include exact COSE_Sign1 hex, Sig_structure hex, SHA-256 digest, signature hex.
2. slots_array_mutation — valid envelope signature, payload slots bytes altered -> MUST fail verification. THE regression case for the parent bead (old code verified only ordinal/IID/superframe_id, coap_slot_coord.c:316-337).
3. claim_seq_replay_equal / replay_lower — two claims same IID, second with claim_seq <= first -> receiver MUST reject (drives the NV high-water child).
4. expiry_boundary — now-1 (reject), now (reject: spec says expiry > now, :192), now+1 (accept). Use fixed timestamps.
5. header_alg_decoy — protected h'a10139ffff' ({1: -65536}, the spec/08:135 typo) -> MUST reject; h'47A1013A00010000' ({1: -65537}) -> accept.
6. kid_payload_iid_mismatch — unprotected {4: kid} != payload key 5 -> reject (spec step 6, :191).
7. ordinal_absent — 6-key payload without key 7 -> reject (receiver needs ordinal for register_gateway, coap_slot_coord.c:376).
8. expired_claim_stripped_seq / sig_over_wrong_payload — reuse-one-signature-across-two-payloads demonstrator: same sig attached to two different canonical payloads, exactly one verifies.

Schema: follow gcp_handoff_cose_sign1.json structure (include Sig_structure, signature_input field = "SHA256(CBOR(Sig_structure))", expected verify outcome per case, and a "reject_reason" aligned with the C enum values LICHEN_CLAIM_* where meaningful).

Acceptance criteria:
- JSON + generator committed; generator runs offline (fixed keys, no network) and reproduces the JSON byte-for-byte.
- Every case states expected outcome and reason; positives verify against python/src/lichen/crypto/schnorr48.py as the independent oracle (sign in generator, cross-check verify).
- Cases 2, 3, 4, 5, 7 are present (parent-bead-specific) and cross-referenced from the qpco.4 vector list.
- Existing test/vectors/gcp_slot_claim.json + gcp6_slot_coordination.json left untouched (old model; retired by the cross-validation child).
